title: Sadaka Iliyobadilisha Hatima
intro: Katika siku za mwanzo za ubinadamu, roho ilitoa zawadi kwa nia safi. Hata hivyo, wivu ulijificha kwenye kivuli cha kukubalika. Gundua hadithi ya mtu huyu ambaye uchaji wake na mwisho wake wa kusikitisha hautakufa katika ufunuo wa kimungu.
clues: Nilikuwa miongoni mwa vizazi vya kwanza kabisa vya wanadamu.
Nilimtolea Bwana wangu sadaka, nayo ikapokelewa kwa neema.
Sadaka ya kaka yangu ilikataliwa, na wivu ukamtia giza moyoni mwake.
Nilimwambia, 'Ukininyooshea mkono wako kuniua, mimi sitanyooshea mkono wangu kukuua; hakika mimi namwogopa Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola wa walimwengu wote.'
Nikawa mwathirika wa kitendo cha kwanza cha mauaji duniani.
Damu yangu ililia, nami nilikuwa shahidi wa kwanza asiye na hatia.

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
